rites.name: Thuzhournun
rites.text: Thuzhournun is the concept of a resonant hum that condensed into the first roots of Tarnornath during the Singing, when the world was still soft and unsettled. It is less a being than a pattern of tone that shaped where matter would settle and hold.

rites.name: Rornium
rites.text: A legendary binding pact that a dark-arts practitioner may acquire from a noble lord. It grants its holder a sworn, lasting connection to the arcane craft.

rites.name: Kelestude
rites.text: Kelestude is a tectonic warden-engine of Tarnornath's Grounded realm, a mantle-bound colossus that stamps the earth to hold the continents still. When its keel-fists strike together, the strain rings through the crust for kilometers and can shear a valley open in a single blow.

rites.name: Taustialia
rites.text: A revered binding craft held by warlock circles that can be unmade to yield materials for improving other works.

rites.name: Orellontus
rites.text: A discipline of channeling tempest energies that a practitioner earns after completing a trial of initiation. It shapes the caster's magic into the form of gathering storms.

rites.name: Neornalia
rites.text: A battle-craft in which a caster channels a falling storm into a crushing blow delivered at close quarters. It is practiced by mystics who call the sky to their fists.

rites.name: Corialises
rites.text: A dread chant made by sorcerers that tears apart every living thing and every spirit able to hear it. The one who sings it is spared, though how they manage this remains unclear to scholars.

rites.name: Corolia
rites.text: A seeker undertakes a trial that opens during a sacred rite of nine. Those who complete it are granted a tailored form of an enduring force.

rites.name: Amiasium
rites.text: A bitter binding that is laid upon a wronged soul so that it seeks retribution. It is one of three trials that belong to a wider path of trials, and it is sought out by those who follow that path.

rites.name: Ristor Valirolor
rites.text: A ritual trial that is opened during a sacred nine-part observance. Those who complete it are granted a refined version of an old lethal technique.

rites.name: Corontaunus
rites.text: A forbidden ritual lets a dying mind move into a new body. It is condemned as a heresy because it lets weaker folk seize the power of a warrior.

rites.name: Senanum
rites.text: A forbidden craft that calls back those who have already died through strange, unseen powers. Its wielders are scorned by orthodox priesthoods, though a few heretical rulers secretly study it.

rites.name: Amintaulum
rites.text: A trial undertaken by seekers who pursue a hidden sacred card within a deck of divining tokens. Those who complete it gain access to a major mystic arcana.

rites.name: Drokaiggak
rites.text: Drokaiggak is a concept in Tarnornath, a sleeping power of the Seeding that stirs only when the makers plant the Weave in the Holy Age of flame and temples. It is remembered as a quiet force bound to the orders that tend the sacred fires.

rites.name: Tolor
rites.text: A wielder of arcane fire calls forth a blazing sunrise that turns a sworn blade into a weapon of radiant flame.

rites.name: Nines
rites.text: A bold gesture that a wandering warrior can learn at the very start of their journey. It is a rare display of celebration, shared through simple movement.

rites.name: Cillum
rites.text: A legendary bond sworn to a spellcaster of the arcane arts, granted by a distant mystic who trades in such oaths. It offers its bearer a lasting connection to the scavenging sky-hunter.

rites.name: Cirnor Amiasum
rites.text: A charged trance that a storm-minded caster enters to gain command of lightning. It is a supernatural ability wielded by a specialist of the tempest arts.

rites.name: Vastaurnes
rites.text: A protective barrier that certain foes raise in the middle of a clash. It soaks up incoming harm to shield its wielder from attacks.

rites.name: Saunanum Laurnum
rites.text: A variant of ordinary portents that behaves nearly the same, yet is wrapped in a shimmering protective ward that sets it apart from its plainer kin.

rites.name: Vaustornum
rites.text: A shadow-tainted form of a sacred essence, born when a deep-hearted wish reawakens a zealous warrior. This murky tide grants its wielders uncanny, unsettling powers.

rites.name: Raulantanum
rites.text: A mystical capacity allows a being to return from death and walk again among the living. Scholars regard this return as a force that lies beyond ordinary cause and effect.

rites.name: Mianeth
rites.text: Mianeth is a concept of the Tarnornath Pact, a binding oath sworn in the aftermath of the Fall and the Sundering. It names the shared promise by which the Shards agreed to keep their broken worlds from breaking again.

rites.name: Oriaresanum
rites.text: A guardian craft that unlocks once a fighter reaches a set rank, built around raising deployable barriers that soak up incoming harm. Its great ward can also strengthen nearby allies while it stands.

rites.name: Amolestium
rites.text: A rare bond that lies dormant within a being until awakened. It can be passed from one bearer to another through a sealed keeper-chamber, and when broken down it yields materials used to strengthen other bonds.

rites.name: Teosanum Sanor
rites.text: A close-combat technique that changes how a fighter's hand-to-hand blows work. Each such technique belongs to one specific training path, and its recharge time can be shortened by sturdy gear or enhancements fitted to protective wear.

rites.name: Sonausum
rites.text: A keeper-class caster who wields a radiant ward that deals wide area harm and cuts the recharge of hurled blasts while it burns. It unlocks once a wielder's hand has reached the fifteenth rung of skill, and it leans toward guarding allies over striking foes.

rites.name: Oriaseorus
rites.text: A bearer's hardiness, mending, and quickness are shaped by the path they follow within their order. Each path grants a strong boost to one of these three traits.

rites.name: Serelleonia
rites.text: A bond between two or three fighters who act together in perfect step, close as siblings. The pairing was first recorded among a trio of warriors from a distant red world, and later among sisters and other combatants.

rites.name: Sillum Meleonia
rites.text: A decisive closing strike used to bring down a foe whose strength has nearly run out. It was introduced in a later chapter of the saga.

rites.name: Ameolanum Tirnausor
rites.text: A modifier that rides on certain strikes and blades, one of the two opposing forces of radiance and gloom. Those who wield it can turn it to their advantage, and it touches both champions and foes alike.

rites.name: Ameolum
rites.text: A gift bestowed by a shadowy hidden force that lets a person pierce false appearances and glimpse the lingering traces of bygone happenings.

rites.name: Niasanum
rites.text: A bundled art of sharp hurling spines, practiced only by one restricted class of weavers. It unleashes a violent volley of barbs upon the enemies gathered before the caster.

rites.name: Dreruden
rites.text: Dreruden is a concept of Tarnornath's Walled Age, the idea of a holding wall that answers to its builders' oaths and guards a valley for centuries. In the Age of Sundering it was the principle that let the first crossings be argued over rather than simply fought. Its power is measured in the stone and will it can gather, not in spectacle.

rites.name: Niastellus
rites.text: A fiery discipline practiced by sorcerers who channel radiant flame into a blade. It belongs to the wielder's chosen path of casting.

rites.name: Amores
rites.text: A gilded firearm-like power that a marksman-style fighter can call upon as a special ability. It belongs to the hunter class and is wielded by those who favor the revolver's craft.

rites.name: Tauranum
rites.text: A warrior leaps high into the air and slams down, releasing a crackling blue energy burst that scorches all foes inside a wide ring around the impact.

rites.name: Naliastum
rites.text: A practitioner rises after a leap and hangs aloft, drifting above the ground. Holding this aloft demands full focus, so the practitioner cannot strike with a weapon while drifting.

rites.name: Ceollontia
rites.text: A discipline of spellcasters who weave light fractured through many hues into their craft. It is taught to those who follow the caller's path.

rites.name: Nosines
rites.text: A sun-bright inner glow that a chosen wielder of hurled blasts and close strikes can call forth. While it burns, their throws and blows gain strength and recover faster, with throws gaining the greater benefit.

rites.name: Cillanum Amiasontor
rites.text: A glowing ball of energy that forms when a warrior unleashes a powerful gift, and any nearby ally can seize it to rapidly refill their own reserve of strength.

rites.name: Maures
rites.text: A mid-air technique that lets a wielder take an extra bound or drift while still airborne. Each practitioner's form is tied to their own discipline, and it can be repeated as often as one can leap.

rites.name: Orolum
rites.text: A ceremonial hand gesture that a wanderer can learn and display from the very beginning of their journey. It sends a fine spray of droplets across the surrounding air.

rites.name: Corantia
rites.text: A ritual dance gesture that a spellweaver may adopt in their repertoire of expressive movements. It is available to casters of the lowest rank.

rites.name: Liarium Lostor
rites.text: A bundle of powers and traits that a chosen warrior swaps and upgrades to advance. It serves as the main path through which champions grow stronger over time.

rites.name: Tantium Cianor
rites.text: A warden can raise a dark-glowing barrier that shields the group. Companions who fire through it strike harder, and guarding allies keeps the wall standing longer.

rites.name: Ameontus Lauseonus
rites.text: A small burning charge conjured from sunlit power and hurled by cult servants of the underworld. It bursts into flame on impact, scattering heat across the area.

rites.name: Ameontor
rites.text: A practitioner's craft of holding dark, frozen forces in check through a binding discipline. It belongs to a class of warlock arts that draw on the stillness of frost.

rites.name: Lesor
rites.text: A ranged fighting discipline that lets a warrior unleash a distant blast able to clear crowds and deny ground without drawing close to enemies.

rites.name: Amausorium
rites.text: A long trial through which a caster earns the right to command tempests. Its completion is granted only after a prior campaign battle is finished.

rites.name: Oreostia Sereosantia
rites.text: A bonded discipline that a seeker may claim through a trial of tokens. Once mastered, it grants a new technique to those who wield frozen, still-forces.

rites.name: Costanum Reniases
rites.text: A fierce combat discipline in which a warrior channels a volatile inner storm through a hooked, entwined weave of energy. The practice grants raw strength to those who wield it, at the cost of control.

rites.name: Sileosor
rites.text: A short-ranged hurled charge that, on striking anything, collapses a ring of flame inward and then sends up to three searing bolts of sunfire through the enemies it encircled, burning them lightly.

rites.name: Valeosum Leontenus
rites.text: A hurled orb bounces off creatures and walls, then bursts on the ground to freeze nearby foes. A low seeker then drifts to another target and locks it in ice.

rites.name: Rialum Rernilanum
rites.text: A reshaping craft that lets its practitioner pass into a different destined form. It is recorded as a gift that arrives with a later journey of the wanderer.

rites.name: Tesauntanum
rites.text: A ruler gathers power from the bewilderment of others, drawing strength whenever rivals are deceived or fail to grasp the schemes behind their own dealings. Hidden tunnels beneath a palace host the mechanism that feeds this tithe.

rites.name: Amirum
rites.text: A guided plunge into a lightless hollow that introduces a traveler to the shadowed craft of the void. It serves as a first lesson for those drawn to this dark art.

rites.name: Oriarnum
rites.text: A fiery battle-chant that a mage can unleash to channel burning power. It can be drawn upon by practitioners of two distinct magical traditions.

rites.name: Reoresium
rites.text: A solitary exercise practiced by one person at a time, first taught together with a gateway device during a period of renewal. It lets a lone practitioner train and test their skill without companions.

rites.name: Seniantes
rites.text: A trial in which a newcomer learns to command crackling lightning, guided by a sky-attuned tutor. It marks the first step toward mastering the storm-channeling craft.

rites.name: Haleduren
rites.text: Haleduren is a concept-realm of the Tarnornath omniverse, a grounded and age-seven dominion whose sovereign is a quiet, dispersed mind woven through the local gravity of a single world's orbit. Its inhabitants treat their own weight as a kind of sacred debt, and its ruling council meets only when tides align. The place holds together by the patient, unhurried pull that keeps its circuits of stars and moons in tune.

rites.name: Crarnustock
rites.text: Crarnustock is a patient, memory-devouring deep-current that drifts through the sunken archives of Tarnornath, feeding on recollections until whole generations forget their own names. Ancient ferrymen once lured it into hollow reliquaries of salt-glass, where its appetite could be bargained with rather than fought.

rites.name: Pelordath
rites.text: Pelordath is a quiet, bottle-green stormfield of charged mist that drifts over the salt marshes of Tarnornath, rarely more than a few meters tall. Its residents are marsh-fishers who believe it remembers the names of drowned things and hums them back at dusk. When it passes over a settlement, buried iron rusts into fine green dust within a day.

rites.name: Joruneld
rites.text: Joruneld is a fabricated sentinel-engine of the Tarnornath archives, a mind of brass lattices built in the second age to stand watch over the lamp-towns of the Grounded realm. Its records describe it as a steady guardian that weighs the wind against the dark, though its authors left few details on how it acted.

rites.name: Kelune
rites.text: Kelune is a set of attuned wardcraft practiced by the lantern-sworn of the Tarnornath cloisters, who channel borrowed dawnfire and tidal dusk into mantles worn over the body. Each practitioner's discipline, once taught in full, determines which of the many branches of the art they may learn, and branches are unlocked slowly through trial and devotion.

rites.name: Nallus
rites.text: A guardian discipline drawn from the empty dark between worlds, practiced by defenders who shape it into a shield. Its wielders stand watch over allies, hardening their ranks against the approaching threat.

rites.name: Rostiallus
rites.text: A caster can unleash a close blast that clears weak foes, or charge it for greater reach and power. Sprinting triggers a short teleport, and the blast can follow its end. Using this power restores all of the caster's other abilities.

rites.name: Lauror
rites.text: A blended craft that fuses the light-born and shadow-born arts into one practice. When both reservoirs are brimming, the wielder ascends into a state that hardens them against harm, empowers their strikes, and releases a unique burst.

rites.name: Valoria
rites.text: A drifting hunter's craft that binds a whole crowd of enemies to a dark tether point. The bound foes move sluggishly and cannot speak or cast, giving allies room to act.

rites.name: Moneorus
rites.text: A dark, frozen craft that a wielder draws upon to halt and hold enemies in place. It is practiced as a specialized discipline of shadow and cold.

rites.name: Orianteonum
rites.text: A practitioner channels a dark, consuming force to annihilate foes, trading protection for raw destructive power. Their greatest technique hurls a blast of hungry shadow that dissolves everything it touches.

rites.name: Canes Seriarnia
rites.text: Shifting unseen pathways run beneath the world and beyond it, letting travelers cross great distances in both the material realm and the realm above.

rites.name: Vantus Oriasoranum
rites.text: A force that ignores the usual rules of nature, shaping beings and abilities that act beyond ordinary cause and effect.

rites.name: Telirnus
rites.text: A craft that braids together the opposing forces of radiance and shadow into one discipline. Practitioners borrow techniques, flares, and guiding principles from every school of practice.

rites.name: Amesanum
rites.text: Chosen defenders call on a cosmic arcane force granted by a distant wanderer, unleashing their most potent strike against enemies threatening their city. Each defender's class shapes a distinct burst of power.

rites.name: Halernath
rites.text: Halernath is a concept of the Tarnornath omniverse, the principle that a single landfall can split a people from the bonds that once held them together. In the Three Futures it is shelved in the Library as one branch of an ending that never quite closes. Its story is told in the grounded terms of the Age of Sundering, where small fractures become lasting divides.
